about.title: About PrivacyBulkWebP
about.tagline: The most privacy-focused bulk WebP image converter — 100% local processing, zero data collection.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: We believe everyone deserves a privacy-first image conversion tool. Your images are your own, and they should never be uploaded to a third-party server without your consent.
mission.p2: That's why PrivacyBulkWebP performs 100% of its processing locally in your browser. Your images never leave your device — not even for a second.
mission.p3: No server uploads. No data collection. No privacy compromises. Just fast, reliable image conversion that respects your rights.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Drag and drop your images or use the file picker to select them.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Select your preferred quality level and compression mode — standard, lossy, lossless, or custom.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Images are converted using the Canvas API directly in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Download individual files or grab them all in a single ZIP file.
howItWorks.localNote: All processing happens entirely on your device.

why.title: Why Choose Us
why.privacyDesc: Zero server uploads. All image processing happens locally in your browser.
why.fastDesc: Built on the modern Canvas API with optimized batch processing for speed.
why.flexibleDesc: Free tier for everyone, with affordable premium plans for power users.
why.noRegDesc: Start converting images immediately — no sign-up, no account needed.
why.crossDesc: Works on any modern browser — Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and more.

tech.title: Technology
tech.item1: Built with modern web technologies for reliability and speed.
tech.item2: Canvas API for real, high-quality image conversion.
tech.item3: WebP encoding natively in the browser — no plugins required.
tech.item4: JSZip for convenient batch downloads in a single ZIP file.
tech.item5: No third-party image processing services — everything stays local.
